Name: Updated Vanilla Portraits
Author: wallflower9596
Description:
Hi! 

I wanted to edit the vanilla portraits and sprites for Leah, Penny, Sam, and Sebastian, because in my mind they looked different and so I decided to take a crack at making this mod.

I am including each townie as a different folder so after you download the mod, you can take out whichever character you don't want. Just go into the folder, open the character's folder and remove whichever you want. That character will remain in the content.json file, however it will not have anything to load so it will just go back to the default vanilla version.

Leah~

made her hair a light brown
gave her a new shirt because I hate the overalls
gave her a new wedding sprite because I can 
changed the 'bow' legs into the straight ones
some other small changes

Penny~ 

Gave her new clothes
Changed up her hair to a braid in Spring - Fall, and long hair for Beach/Winter
Cute flower dance outfit
added freckles

Sam~

New clothes
I quite literally just put a hat on his ~interesting~ hair
Changed his skateboard color
gave him freckles and face piercings

Sebastian~

Literally just piercings

*POTENTIAL ADD ONS*
seasonal outfits (not sure how to do this yet)



I may add on more characters in the future, but this is what I have so far

Let me know what questions/suggestions you have, or if anything needs to be fixed!
